record.bible_text: Listen<WH08085><WTH8798>, O isles<WH0339>, unto me; and hearken<WH07181><WTH8685>, ye people<WH03816>, from far<WH07350>; The LORD<WH03068> hath called<WH07121><WTH8804> me from the womb<WH0990>; from the bowels<WH04578> of my mother<WH0517> hath he made mention<WH02142><WTH8689> of my name<WH08034>.

And he hath made<WH07760><WTH8799> my mouth<WH06310> like a sharp<WH02299> sword<WH02719>; in the shadow<WH06738> of his hand<WH03027> hath he hid<WH02244><WTH8689> me, and made<WH07760><WTH8799> me a polished<WH01305><WTH8803> shaft<WH02671>; in his quiver<WH0827> hath he hid<WH05641><WTH8689> me;
And said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto me, Thou <FI>art<Fi> my servant<WH05650>, O Israel<WH03478>, in whom I will be glorified<WH06286><WTH8691>.

Then I said<WH0559><WTH8804>, I have laboured<WH03021><WTH8804> in vain<WH07385>, I have spent<WH03615><WTH8765> my strength<WH03581> for nought<WH08414>, and in vain<WH01892>: <FI>yet<Fi> surely<WH0403> my judgment<WH04941> <FI>is<Fi> with the LORD<WH03068>, and my work<WH06468> with my God<WH0430>. <RF>my work: or, my reward<Rf>

And now, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> that formed<WH03335><WTH8802> me from the womb<WH0990> <FI>to be<Fi> his servant<WH05650>, to bring<WH07725><WH00> Jacob<WH03290> again<WH07725><WTH8788> to him, Though Israel<WH03478> be not gathered<WH0622><WTH8735>, yet shall I be glorious<WH03513><WTH8735> in the eyes<WH05869> of the LORD<WH03068>, and my God<WH0430> shall be my strength<WH05797>. <RF>Though...: or, That Israel may be gathered to him, and I may, etc<Rf>

And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, It is a light thing<WH07043><WTH8738> that thou shouldest be my servant<WH05650> to raise up<WH06965><WTH8687> the tribes<WH07626> of Jacob<WH03290>, and to restore<WH07725><WTH8687> the preserved<WH05341><WTH8803><WTH8675><WH05336> of Israel<WH03478>: I will also give<WH05414><WTH8804> thee for a light<WH0216> to the Gentiles<WH01471>, that thou mayest be my salvation<WH03444> unto the end<WH07097> of the earth<WH0776>. <RF>It is...: or, Art thou lighter than that thou shouldest, etc<Rf> <RF>preserved: or, desolations<Rf><CM>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, the Redeemer<WH01350><WTH8802> of Israel<WH03478>, <FI>and<Fi> his Holy One<WH06918>, to him whom man<WH05315> despiseth<WH0960>, to him whom the nation<WH01471> abhorreth<WH08581><WTH8764>, to a servant<WH05650> of rulers<WH04910><WTH8802>, Kings<WH04428> shall see<WH07200><WTH8799> and arise<WH06965><WTH8804>, princes<WH08269> also shall worship<WH07812><WTH8691>, because of the LORD<WH03068> that is faithful<WH0539><WTH8737>, <FI>and<Fi> the Holy One<WH06918> of Israel<WH03478>, and he shall choose<WH0977><WTH8799> thee. <RF>whom man...: or, that is despised in soul<Rf>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, In an acceptable<WH07522> time<WH06256> have I heard<WH06030><WTH8804> thee, and in a day<WH03117> of salvation<WH03444> have I helped<WH05826><WTH8804> thee: and I will preserve<WH05341><WTH8799> thee, and give<WH05414><WTH8799> thee for a covenant<WH01285> of the people<WH05971>, to establish<WH06965><WTH8687> the earth<WH0776>, to cause to inherit<WH05157><WTH8687> the desolate<WH08074><WTH8802> heritages<WH05159>; <RF>establish: or, raise up<Rf>

That thou mayest say<WH0559><WTH8800> to the prisoners<WH0631><WTH8803>, Go forth<WH03318><WTH8798>; to them that <FI>are<Fi> in darkness<WH02822>, Shew<WH01540><WTH8734> yourselves. They shall feed<WH07462><WTH8799> in the ways<WH01870>, and their pastures<WH04830> <FI>shall be<Fi> in all high places<WH08205>.

They shall not hunger<WH07456><WTH8799> nor thirst<WH06770><WTH8799>; neither shall the heat<WH08273> nor sun<WH08121> smite<WH05221><WTH8686> them: for he that hath mercy<WH07355><WTH8764> on them shall lead<WH05090><WTH8762> them, even by the springs<WH04002> of water<WH04325> shall he guide<WH05095><WTH8762> them.
And I will make<WH07760><WTH8804> all my mountains<WH02022> a way<WH01870>, and my highways<WH04546> shall be exalted<WH07311><WTH8799>.
Behold, these shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> from far<WH07350>: and, lo, these from the north<WH06828> and from the west<WH03220>; and these from the land<WH0776> of Sinim<WH05515>.<CM>

Sing<WH07442><WTH8798>, O heavens<WH08064>; and be joyful<WH01523><WTH8798>, O earth<WH0776>; and break forth<WH06476><WTH8798> into singing<WH07440>, O mountains<WH02022>: for the LORD<WH03068> hath comforted<WH05162><WTH8765> his people<WH05971>, and will have mercy<WH07355><WTH8762> upon his afflicted<WH06041>.
But Zion<WH06726> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, The LORD<WH03068> hath forsaken<WH05800><WTH8804> me, and my Lord<WH0136> hath forgotten<WH07911><WTH8804> me.

Can a woman<WH0802> forget<WH07911><WTH8799> her sucking child<WH05764>, that she should not have compassion<WH07355><WTH8763> on the son<WH01121> of her womb<WH0990>? yea, they may forget<WH07911><WTH8799>, yet will I not forget<WH07911><WTH8799> thee. <RF>that...: Heb. from having compassion<Rf>
Behold, I have graven<WH02710><WTH8804> thee upon the palms of <FI>my<Fi> hands<WH03709>; thy walls<WH02346> <FI>are<Fi> continually<WH08548> before me.
Thy children<WH01121> shall make haste<WH04116><WTH8765>; thy destroyers<WH02040><WTH8764> and they that made thee waste<WH02717><WTH8688> shall go forth<WH03318><WTH8799> of thee.<CM>

Lift up<WH05375><WTH8798> thine eyes<WH05869> round about<WH05439>, and behold<WH07200><WTH8798>: all these gather themselves together<WH06908><WTH8738>, <FI>and<Fi> come<WH0935><WTH8804> to thee. <FI>As<Fi>  I live<WH02416>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, thou shalt surely clothe<WH03847><WTH8799> thee with them all, as with an ornament<WH05716>, and bind<WH07194><WTH8762> them <FI>on thee<Fi> , as a bride<WH03618> <FI>doeth<Fi> .

For thy waste<WH02723> and thy desolate places<WH08074><WTH8802>, and the land<WH0776> of thy destruction<WH02035>, shall even now be too narrow<WH03334><WTH8799> by reason of the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802>, and they that swallowed thee up<WH01104><WTH8764> shall be far away<WH07368><WTH8804>.

The children<WH01121> which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost<WH07923> the other, shall say<WH0559><WTH8799> again in thine ears<WH0241>, The place<WH04725> <FI>is<Fi> too strait<WH06862> for me: give<WH05066><WTH8798> place<WH04725> to me that I may dwell<WH03427><WTH8799>.

Then shalt thou say<WH0559><WTH8804> in thine heart<WH03824>, Who hath begotten<WH03205><WTH8804> me these, seeing I have lost my children<WH07921><WTH8803>, and am desolate<WH01565>, a captive<WH01540><WTH8802>, and removing to and fro<WH05493><WTH8803>? and who hath brought up<WH01431><WTH8765> these? Behold, I was left<WH07604><WTH8738> alone; these, where<WH0375> <FI>had<Fi> they <FI>been<Fi> ?

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, Behold, I will lift up<WH05375><WTH8799> mine hand<WH03027> to the Gentiles<WH01471>, and set up<WH07311><WTH8686> my standard<WH05251> to the people<WH05971>: and they shall bring<WH0935><WTH8689> thy sons<WH01121> in <FI>their<Fi> arms<WH02684>, and thy daughters<WH01323> shall be carried<WH05375><WTH8735> upon <FI>their<Fi> shoulders<WH03802>. <RF>arms: Heb. bosom<Rf>

And kings<WH04428> shall be thy nursing fathers<WH0539><WTH8802>, and their queens<WH08282> thy nursing mothers<WH03243><WTH8688>: they shall bow down<WH07812><WTH8691> to thee with <FI>their<Fi> face<WH0639> toward the earth<WH0776>, and lick up<WH03897><WTH8762> the dust<WH06083> of thy feet<WH07272>; and thou shalt know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>: for they shall not be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> that wait<WH06960><WTH8802> for me. <RF>nursing fathers: Heb. nourishers<Rf> <RF>queens: Heb. princesses<Rf><CM>
Shall the prey<WH04455> be taken<WH03947><WTH8714> from the mighty<WH01368>, or the lawful<WH06662> captive<WH07628> delivered<WH04422><WTH8735>? <RF>lawful...: Heb. captivity of the just<Rf>

But thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, Even the captives<WH07628> of the mighty<WH01368> shall be taken away<WH03947><WTH8714>, and the prey<WH04455> of the terrible<WH06184> shall be delivered<WH04422><WTH8735>: for I will contend<WH07378><WTH8799> with him that contendeth<WH03401> with thee, and I will save<WH03467><WTH8686> thy children<WH01121>. <RF>captives: Heb. captivity<Rf>

And I will feed<WH0398><WTH8689> them that oppress<WH03238><WTH8688> thee with their own flesh<WH01320>; and they shall be drunken<WH07937><WTH8799> with their own blood<WH01818>, as with sweet wine<WH06071>: and all flesh<WH01320> shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I the LORD<WH03068> <FI>am<Fi> thy Saviour<WH03467><WTH8688> and thy Redeemer<WH01350><WTH8802>, the mighty One<WH046> of Jacob<WH03290>. <RF>sweet: or, new<Rf><CM>
